verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing support. Admins can limit what non-admin portal users see, so they don't see the full cap table (docs-14, docs-46), but this describes investors and employees, not delegated third parties. Cake can also automatically notify a company's registered agent of share issuances, transfers and conversions, which is a narrow push-based slice of equity data going to an outside party (docs-21). missing for 10: scoped delegated access or roles for external firms such as law firms, HRIS vendors and wealth managers; scoped API tokens or OAuth-style grants (no public API spec found, probe-2); per-third-party permission controls; independent corroboration.
